name: Skemify Store Migration
author: Skemify

sections.installation:
1. Upload the skemify-store-migration folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Skemify Store Migration settings page to configure your migration options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support all versions of WooCommerce?

Yes, Skemify is compatible with WooCommerce version 3.0 and above.

What data can I migrate using Skemify?

You can migrate products, customers, orders, and more from Shopify, WooCommerce, and Wix.

Is my data safe during the migration?

Absolutely! Skemify ensures that all data transfers are secure and complies with best practices to keep your information safe.

Do I need any coding knowledge to use this plugin?

No, Skemify is designed for users of all skill levels, and no coding knowledge is required to perform migrations.
sections.description:
Description

Migrate your store data between Shopify, Wix, Squarespace, Square, WooCommerce, Magento and Prestashop with Skemify.

Skemify Store Migration

Skemify is a powerful store migration plugin that simplifies the transfer of your products, customers, and orders. It ensures secure, lossless, and efficient migrations tailored for e-commerce platforms.

With Skemify, you can:
– Easily migrate products, variants, categories, discounts and including images and descriptions.
– Transfer customer data securely.
– Move orders and transaction history.
– Enjoy an intuitive interface designed for users of all skill levels.
– Perform migration for up to 100 of entities.
– Get professional tech support.

Important Notice – Use of 3rd Party Service

This plugin relies on the use of a third-party SaaS (Software as a Service) to facilitate the migration process between different eCommerce platforms.
By using this plugin, your store data will be securely transferred via our external service.

The data transmitted may include product details, customer information, orders, categories, and other store-related data.
This service is necessary to perform the migration functionality as described.
By using this plugin, you agree to allow the transfer of data between your store and the SaaS platform.
Skemify app for Shopify: https://apps.shopify.com/skemify-wix-store-migration
Skemify app for Wix: https://www.wix.com/market/web-solution/skemify-store-migration
Privacy Policy: https://skemify.com/privacy-policy.html

Assets

icon: logo-256.png

Feedback

Acknowledgments

Thank you for using Skemify! We appreciate your support in helping us improve the plugin. If you find it useful, please consider leaving a review.
